events.title: Huge Update for the Demo
events.summary: Hey Weaponsmiths!Steam Next Fest is LIVE, and Fantasy Weaponsmith Simulator is part of it.To celebrate, I've just released a huge demo update!The main change is haggling, which I rebuilt from scratch. Customers now make real counteroffers, and you can see their patience run out. Push your price too far and they get offended. events.title: Demo Update v0.7.0
events.summary: Haggling, ReworkedOne price on the table. The haggle panel now shows a single price. Set it digit by digit (step the ones, tens or hundreds up and down), then hold to submit.At the customer's price the button reads Sell, and above it the button reads Offer, so you always know which one you're doing.Customers make real counteroffers. events.title: Engrave cool patterns on your weapons!

And if you've got thoughts, good or bad, I want to hear them.Today I'll continue with another mechanic deep dive. This time it's the Engraving StationWhat is it?It's where you inscribe a weapon with a lore — an engraving that grants stat buffs and stamps the weapon with its own unique tag. events.title: Demo is OUT!
events.summary: Demo is RELEASED!Hey Weaponsmiths!It's finally here!The demo is live, and you can now try a slice of the game.I'm both thrilled and terrified to finally put this in players' hands. It's been a long road of passion, late nights, and more than a few setbacks, but I'm finally able to have something to show.So go forge something, haggle hard, and let me know what you think. Every bit of feedback helps shape where this goes next.Another update coming soon ~ Stay tuned!
